MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Dot feels useful because it adds convenient Alexa voice control alongside my Fire TV devices without requiring another screen.",
    "The Avantree headphones fit a specific use for my TV setup: private listening, provided they work with my devices."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The HD Fire TV Stick adds little because I already have a 4K stick and a Fire TV television; a familiar device is not useful when it duplicates what I own.",
    "The memory cards, flash drive, and internal SSD address storage needs I haven't identified. Owning cameras and other electronics doesn't mean I currently need those accessories.",
    "The router and tablet could be useful in some circumstances, but I have no current reason to replace my router or add another screen."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire TV purchases seem to have been taken as interest in more Amazon devices, even when another device would repeat an existing function.",
    "My electronics purchases seem to have been treated as broad interest in storage and networking equipment, without a specific task that would make me choose them."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "What matters to me is whether an item adds a useful capability to my existing setup, such as voice control or private TV listening.",
    "Compatibility and an immediate need matter before I buy an accessory; a camera purchase alone doesn't tell me which memory card I need.",
    "Even when two Alexa speakers both fit my interests, I'd choose the smaller Echo Dot this time rather than buy both."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in connected home entertainment, but missed the difference between useful additions and purchases that duplicate existing functions or solve no current need."
}
